description_en: Queries the AccessKey pairs of an Alibaba Cloud account or a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 查询阿里云账号（主账号）或RAM用户的访问密钥列表
name: ListAccessKeys

parameters.description_en:
The logon name of the RAM user.

If this parameter is empty, the AccessKey pairs of the current user are queried.
parameters.description_zh:
RAM用户的登录名称。

如果为空，默认查询当前用户的所有访问密钥。
parameters.help_en:
